messages:
Sara (Product): Heads-up — ACME reached out asking for a packaged integration we can list on the Marketplace: JS SDK + Terraform provider + SCIM/SSO wiring. They want an end-to-end sample and GA-level docs.
Ben (Sales): Customer is willing to commit to a pilot if ETA is <8 weeks and we provide migration support. They care about SSO + provisioning first.
Alyssa (Support): Do we have an existing SCIM template we can reuse? If not, we should scope minimal SCIM v2 subset (users, groups, provisioning) to start.
Kyle (Eng): Reality check: JS SDK + provider + SCIM is 3 distinct deliverables. Rough ballpark: 3 sprints for SDK + auth hooks, 2 sprints for Terraform provider, 1 sprint for SCIM basics (depending on reuse). Need owner and can parallelize some work.
Sara (Product): Proposal: create a single backlog epic "Connector: ACME marketplace bundle" and attach child stories: sdk-js-auth, terraform-provider, scim-provisioning, docs+samples, e2e tests. Suggest priority P2 with sales-accelerator tag.
Ben (Sales): +1 on epic. Add label customer:acme and expected ARR: $120k ARR so we can escalate if needed.
Alyssa (Support): Acceptance criteria suggestion:
- JS SDK: authenticated example that uses API key + token refresh pattern
- Terraform: resource redwood_integration + example workspace
- SCIM: create/update/deactivate user and group sync in sandbox
- Docs: step-by-step marketplace listing guide
- Tests: automated smoke that runs on PR
Kyle (Eng): For engineering estimation, need minimal API contract for Terraform resource. Something like:
```
resource "redwood_inference_integration" "acme" {
  name = "acme-marketplace"
  model = "redwood/gpt-..."
  region = "us-west-2"
  sso = {
    scim_endpoint = "https://acme.scim"
    bearer_token = "${var.scim_token}"
  }
}
```
That covers provider wiring + secrets.
Devex (DevEx): We should include an example repo under /examples/marketplace/acme and a sample Terraform module. I can own the docs + sample repo if someone on eng owns infra pieces.
integrations-bot: Story created: #INT-8743 epic:INT-8700 assigned:Sara (Product) tags:[integ/sdk, integ/terraform, integ/scim, customer:acme, prio:P2]
Sara (Product): Next steps: Kyle, can you confirm owners for SDK vs Terraform? Devex will draft examples. Ben — let's lock pilot terms in writing. I'll add the epic to the roadmap intake board and flag for PM grooming this Thurs.
Kyle (Eng): I can take Terraform provider ownership. Requesting one additional SWE for SDK (need frontend auth flow + TS types). Can we request cross-functional design meeting Tues?
Ben (Sales): Will send pilot LOI today. Also request that marketplace listing includes a 30-day free trial checkbox for ACME.
Alyssa (Support): I'll prepare SCIM test cases and a checklist for security review.
Sara (Product): Great — I've added labels on the epic: integ_bundle, marketplace_listing, customer_acme. Putting tentative target: beta preview in 6 weeks, GA in 10 weeks. Moving to grooming slot.
Kyle (Eng): Confirmed owners: Terraform = Kyle, SDK = TBD (I'll ping eng leads). QA: Alyssa. DevEx owns examples.
Sara (Product): Thanks everyone. I'll update the intake ticket with acceptance criteria and tagging conventions. If anyone wants different tags, reply here.
Ben (Sales): :thumbsup:
Alyssa (Support): noted.
